/* 主表库存数量补齐：保留经营人口、来源行和未知原因，YQN细仓与库龄独立。 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var node = document.getElementById('inventoryAvailabilityPolishData');
  if (!node || window.spInventoryModel?.ready) return;
  var data = JSON.parse(node.textContent), bySku = new Map(data.rows.map(function (row) { return [row.sku, row]; }));
  var snapshot = data.meta.sourceSnapshotLabel, esc = function (value) { return cxEsc(value == null ? '' : value); };
  var finite = function (value) { return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value); };
  var quantity = function (value) { return finite(value) ? cxQty(value) : '待核'; };
  function applyRecord(target, source) {
    if (!target) return;
    ['available', 'reserved', 'transit'].forEach(function (key) { target[key] = source[key]; });

    target.primaryInventoryEvidence = source;
    target.defaultVisible = true;
    target.masterRegions = source.masterRegions;
    target.regions = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(source.masterRegions).map(function (entry) {
      var region = entry[1];
      return [entry[0], {available_sets:region.available, reserved_sets:region.reserved, in_transit_sets:region.transit, in_transit_reserved_sets:region.transitReserved, source_sheet:region.source.sheet, source_row:region.source.row}];
    }));
  }
  data.rows.forEach(function (row) {
    var stock = typeof sqStockBySku !== 'undefined' ? sqStockBySku.get(row.sku) : null;
    if (stock) applyRecord(stock, row);
    if (typeof cxStockMap !== 'undefined') {
      var other = cxStockMap.get(row.sku);
      if (other && other !== stock) applyRecord(other, row);
    }
  });
  if (typeof sqStockRecord === 'function') {
    var priorStockRecord = sqStockRecord;
    sqStockRecord = function (sku) {
      var result = priorStockRecord(sku), source = bySku.get(sku);
      if (!source) return result;
      return {...result, available:source.available, reserved:source.reserved, transit:source.transit, stock_date:snapshot + '（业务截止未单独声明）', primaryInventoryEvidence:source};
    };
  }
  if (typeof rwData !== 'undefined' && rwData?.rows) {
    var regional = new Map(rwData.rows.map(function (row) { return [row.sku, row]; }));
    rwData.rows.forEach(function (row) { row.defaultVisible = bySku.has(row.sku); });
    data.rows.forEach(function (source) {
      var row = regional.get(source.sku);
      if (!row) { row = {sku:source.sku, defaultVisible:true, warehouses:[], masterRegions:{}}; rwData.rows.push(row); }
      row.defaultVisible = true;
      row.masterRegions = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(source.masterRegions).map(function (entry) {
        var value = entry[1];
        return [entry[0], {...value, sourceSheet:value.source.sheet, sourceRow:value.source.row, date:'文件保存2026-11-13'}];
      }));
      row.primaryInventoryEvidence = source;
    });
    rwData.meta.masterDate = '文件保存2026-11-13';
    rwData.meta.masterMeaning = data.meta.nationalBasis + ' ' + data.meta.sourceDateBasis;
  }
  function sourceText(row) {
    var sources = Object.values(row.masterRegions).map(function (value) { return value.source.sheet + ' 第' + value.source.row + '行（可用' + value.cells.available + '）'; });
    if (sources.length) return sources.join('；');
    return row.historicalSources.length ? row.historicalSources.slice(0,3).map(function (source) { return source.sheet + ' 第' + source.row + '行'; }).join('；') : '当前主表无该精确SKU汇总行';
  }
  function yqnText(row) {
    var value = row.yqnCrosscheck;
    if (finite(value.available)) return 'YQN外仓可用 ' + quantity(value.available) + '套（11/12）；' + (finite(row.available) ? '独立细仓旁证，本版全国数以完整主表为准' : '自有仓及全国仍待核');
    if (finite(value.observedCandidateAvailable)) return 'YQN候选 ' + quantity(value.observedCandidateAvailable) + '套，身份/分包映射待核，不计全国库存';
    return finite(row.available) ? '暂无该SKU可核的YQN独立细仓数量；本版主表数量已核' : '未有可用于补全国库存的YQN证据';
  }
  function sourceAwareHtml(html, row) {
    if (!finite(row.available)) return html;
    var legacy = '内部存在区域预留但未定位到仓；自有仓预留及全国预留保持待核，不拿YQN预留0覆盖';
    var current = '本版主表（文件保存11/13）已核全国可用' + quantity(row.available) + '套、预留' + quantity(row.reserved) + '套、在途' + quantity(row.transit) + '套。YQN与自有仓旧快照仅作独立分源对照；原预留未定位问题不再使本版主表数量待核。';
    return html.replaceAll(esc(legacy), esc(current));
  }
  function table(rows) {
    return cxTable(['库存SKU','核查结果','可用 / 预留 / 在途','主表来源','YQN独立旁证'], rows.map(function (row) {
      return [cxSkuButton(row.sku), esc(row.statusLabel) + '<p class="cx-note">' + esc(row.reason) + '</p>', quantity(row.available) + ' / ' + quantity(row.reserved) + ' / ' + quantity(row.transit), esc(sourceText(row)), esc(yqnText(row))];
    }));
  }
  function auditHtml(skus) {
    var selected = skus ? data.rows.filter(function (row) { return skus.has(row.sku); }) : data.rows;
    var pending = selected.filter(function (row) { return !finite(row.available); });
    var filled = selected.filter(function (row) { return row.newlyResolved; });
    var keys = ['plan_not_registered','historical_only','current_summary_unverified'];
    var labels = {plan_not_registered:'新品/计划尚未登记', historical_only:'仅历史记录', current_summary_unverified:'暂无当前可核汇总'};
    var groups = keys.map(function (key) {
      var rows = pending.filter(function (row) { return row.status === key; });
      return rows.length ? '<details class="cx-fold"><summary>' + esc(labels[key]) + ' · ' + rows.length + '款（展开看SKU与缺项）</summary><div class="cx-fold-body">' + table(rows) + '</div></details>' : '';
    }).join('');
    return '<details class="cx-fold spi-audit"><summary>库存数量与来源核查 · ' + (selected.length - pending.length) + '/' + selected.length + '款有主表数值 · ' + pending.length + '款分原因保留待核</summary><div class="cx-fold-body"><p class="cx-caption">' + esc(snapshot) + '；此为文件版本日期，业务截止未单独声明。已登记CA/GA/NJ汇总按精确SKU合计，主表包含外仓及自有仓；YQN细仓与库龄沿原快照独立查看。</p>' + groups + (filled.length ? '<details class="cx-fold"><summary>本次补齐原缺数SKU · ' + filled.length + '款（包含主表明确0）</summary><div class="cx-fold-body">' + table(filled) + '</div></details>' : '') + '</div></details>';
  }
  if (typeof ldStockLabels !== 'undefined') ldStockLabels.unknown = '主表数量未核（展开看原因）';
  if (typeof rwCards === 'function') {
    var priorCards = rwCards;
    rwCards = function (rows) { return priorCards(rows).replaceAll('主表 · 11/11', '主表 · 文件11/13'); };
  }
  if (typeof wlStatusChart === 'function') {
    var priorStatusChart = wlStatusChart;
    wlStatusChart = function () { return priorStatusChart().replaceAll('三区主表11/11', '三区主表 · 文件11/13'); };
  }
  if (typeof rwReconciliation === 'function') {
    rwReconciliation = function (rows) {
      var sum = function (values) { return values.some(finite) ? values.filter(finite).reduce(function (total, value) { return total + value; }, 0) : null; };
      var master = rwMasterAggregate(rows), external = rows.flatMap(function (row) { return row.warehouses.filter(function (warehouse) { return warehouse.type === 'external' && rwPresent(warehouse); }); });
      var own = rows.flatMap(function (row) { return row.warehouses.filter(function (warehouse) { return warehouse.type === 'own' && rwPresent(warehouse); }); });
      return '<details class="cx-fold rw-reconcile"><summary>来源对账 · 当前主表与独立分仓旁证</summary><div class="cx-fold-body">' + cxTable(['来源口径','快照日期','可用已知小计','数量边界'], [
        ['美国站完整三区主表', esc(snapshot), quantity(master.available), '预留 ' + quantity(master.reserved) + ' / 在途 ' + quantity(master.transit) + '；已含外仓及自有仓，业务截止未单独声明'],
        ['YQN外仓独立旁证', '2026-11-12', quantity(sum(external.map(function (warehouse) { return rwKnown(warehouse, 'available'); }))), '包装完整量缺项仍待核；不加到主表'],
        ['自有仓独立明细旁证', '2026-11-11', quantity(sum(own.map(function (warehouse) { return rwKnown(warehouse, 'available'); }))), '旧批次明细只作定位；已包含在主表，不再相加']
      ]) + '<p class="cx-note">主表国家/仓区汇总与YQN包装明细的来源日期及统计口径不同，差异不能直接认作丢件或新增库存。未列仓区保留缺行，71款缺数按原因展示，不自动补0。</p><p class="cx-source">' + esc(data.meta.primarySource.file) + ' · SHA256 ' + esc(data.meta.primarySource.sha256) + '</p></div></details>';
    };
  }
  if (typeof ldStockCharts === 'function') {
    var priorCharts = ldStockCharts;
    ldStockCharts = function () {
      var result = priorCharts();
      if (cxState.sales.stockScope === 'nonstock') return result;
      var skus = new Set(ldSkuRows(ldOrders('stock'), 'stock').map(function (row) { return row.sku; }));
      return {...result, html:'<p class="cx-note spi-source">库存主来源：' + esc(snapshot) + '；业务截止未单独声明。YQN细仓/库龄不与主表相加。</p>' + result.html + auditHtml(skus)};
    };
  }
  if (typeof cxSkuStockHtml === 'function') {
    var priorSkuStock = cxSkuStockHtml;
    cxSkuStockHtml = function (sku) {
      var row = bySku.get(sku), html = priorSkuStock(sku);
      return row ? '<p class="cx-caption">' + esc(snapshot) + ' · ' + esc(row.statusLabel) + '；' + esc(row.reason) + '</p>' + table([row]) + sourceAwareHtml(html, row).replace('11/11库存表当前在途为0', '本版主表登记在途为0') : html;
    };
  }
  if (typeof sqStockHtml === 'function') {
    var priorQueryStock = sqStockHtml;
    sqStockHtml = function (row) { var source = bySku.get(row.sku), html = priorQueryStock(row); return source ? table([source]) + sourceAwareHtml(html, source) : html; };
  }
  if (typeof wlRender === 'function') {
    var priorWarehouseRender = wlRender;
    wlRender = function () {
      priorWarehouseRender();
      var host = document.getElementById('cxStockBody');
      if (!host) return;
      var option = host.querySelector('option[value="master"]');
      if (option) option.textContent = '完整三区主表 · 文件11/13';
      host.querySelectorAll('.cx-caption').forEach(function (item) {
        if (item.textContent.includes('同源完整主表11/11三区对照')) item.textContent = item.textContent.replace('同源完整主表11/11三区对照；主表已含外仓及自有仓，不再叠加。', snapshot + '，业务截止未单独声明；主表已含外仓及自有仓，不再叠加。');
      });
      var banner = document.createElement('p'); banner.className = 'cx-caption spi-source'; banner.textContent = snapshot + '（文件版本日期，非实时余额）。可用、预留、在途按同一主表；YQN11/12细仓及11/11库龄独立。'; host.prepend(banner);
    };
    rwRender = wlRender; cxRenderStock = wlRender;
  }
  if (typeof sqSalesCache !== 'undefined') sqSalesCache.clear();
  if (typeof ldReferenceCache !== 'undefined') ldReferenceCache.clear();
  if (typeof cxDownloadCsv === 'function') {
    var priorDownloadCsv = cxDownloadCsv;
    cxDownloadCsv = function (filename, headers, rows) {
      var currentName = /^(?:库存与在途|库存分区分仓|SKU数据查询)_/.test(filename) ? filename.replace(/20\d{6}(?=\.csv$)/, '20261116') : filename;
      return priorDownloadCsv(currentName, headers, rows);
    };
  }
  window.spInventoryModel = {ready:true, data:data, bySku:bySku, auditHtml:auditHtml, get:function (sku) { return bySku.get(sku) || null; }};
}());

</script>
<script>
/* 仓库中文区域与真实日期补充。数量沿用已核库存模型，日期不反推、不跨包装版本借用。 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const element = document.getElementById('warehouseDatePolishData');
  if (!element) throw new Error('仓库日期数据未载入');
  const data = JSON.parse(element.textContent);
  const rows = new Map(data.rows.map(row => [row.sku, row]));
  const regions = { CA: '美西', GA: '美东', NJ: '美东北' };
  const esc = value => String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
  })[character]);
  const finite = value => typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value);
  const qty = value => finite(value) ? value.toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) : '待确认';
  const small = text => '<small class="sp-wh-muted">' + esc(text) + '</small>';
  const table = (headers, body) => typeof cxTable === 'function' ? cxTable(headers, body) :
    '<div class="cx-table-wrap"><table><thead><tr>' + headers.map(head => '<th>' + esc(head) + '</th>').join('') +
    '</tr></thead><tbody>' + body.map(row => '<tr>' + row.map(cell => '<td>' + cell + '</td>').join('') + '</tr>').join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';

  function codeOf(value, region) {
    const label = String(value || '');
    if (/自有仓/.test(label)) return 'OWN_' + (region || 'CA');
    return label.match(/([A-Z]{2,5}_(?:CA|GA|NJ))/)?.[1] || null;
  }
  function nameOf(code, region) {
    return data.warehouseLabels[code]?.name || (code ? code + '（' + (regions[region] || '仓区待核') + '）' :
      (regions[region] || '仓区待核') + '（具体仓待确认）');
  }
  function packLabel(group) {
    return (group.packParts || '包数待核') + '包 / ' +
      (group.packVersion === null ? '包装版本待核' : group.packVersion || '原包装');
  }
  const sourceText = references => (references || []).map(source => source.sheet + ' · 第' +
    (source.rows || source.row) + '行').join('；');

  function currentGroups(row, stock) {
    const groups = row.warehouses.filter(group => group.currentEarliestInbound);
    const keys = new Set(groups.map(group => [group.warehouseCode, group.packParts, group.packVersion].join('|')));
    for (const item of stock?.warehouseGroups || []) {
      if (![item.available_complete_sets, item.reserved_complete_sets, item.physical_complete_sets].some(value => finite(value) && value > 0)) continue;
      const code = codeOf(item.warehouse), key = [code, item.pack_parts, item.pack_version || ''].join('|');
      if (keys.has(key)) continue;
      keys.add(key);
      const matching = row.warehouses.find(group => group.warehouseCode === code &&
        group.packParts === item.pack_parts && group.packVersion === (item.pack_version || ''));
      groups.push(matching || { warehouseCode: code, region: code?.split('_')[1], packParts: item.pack_parts,
        packVersion: item.pack_version || '', currentEarliestInbound: null, currentLatestInbound: null });
    }
    return groups.sort((a, b) => String(a.warehouseCode).localeCompare(String(b.warehouseCode)) || packLabel(a).localeCompare(packLabel(b)));
  }

  function datesHtml(sku, stock) {
    const row = rows.get(sku);
    if (!row) return '<section class="sp-wh-panel"><h3>仓库与入库日期</h3><p class="cx-note">该SKU不在本次已核经营库存529款范围，未向其他SKU借用日期。</p></section>';
    const current = currentGroups(row, stock);
    const currentTable = current.length ? table(['仓库 / 中文区域', '包装版本', '当前批次最早入库', '当前批次最近入库'], current.map(group => [
      '<strong>' + esc(nameOf(group.warehouseCode, group.region)) + '</strong>', esc(packLabel(group)),
      esc(group.currentEarliestInbound || '待确认'), esc(group.currentLatestInbound || '待确认')
    ])) : '<p class="sp-wh-empty">主表当前正量批次未取得真实入库日；可展开已接入历史记录查看。</p>';
    const history = row.warehouses.slice().sort((a, b) => String(a.warehouseCode).localeCompare(String(b.warehouseCode)) || packLabel(a).localeCompare(packLabel(b)));
    const historyTable = history.length ? table(['仓库 / 中文区域', '包装版本', '已接入最早入库', '已接入最近入库', '来源'], history.map(group => [
      esc(nameOf(group.warehouseCode, group.region)), esc(packLabel(group)), esc(group.historyEarliestInbound || '待确认'),
      esc(group.historyLatestInbound || '待确认'), '<span class="sp-wh-source">' + esc(sourceText(group.historySources)) + '</span>'
    ])) : '<p class="sp-wh-empty">本次主表与历史页未取得该精确SKU的实际入库记录。</p>';
    const batches = history.flatMap(group => group.batches.filter(batch => batch.currentCartons > 0).map(batch => ({ group, batch })));
    return '<section class="sp-wh-panel" data-sp-warehouse-dates="' + esc(sku) + '"><div class="sp-wh-heading"><h3>分仓入库时间</h3><span>同SKU · 同具体仓 · 同包装版本</span></div>' +
      currentTable + '<p class="cx-note">当前批次日期取主表当前正量在仓、预留或退回包件的原始“入库日期”，含余包；不表示完整套配齐日。主表文件更新于 ' +
      esc(data.masterDateSource) + '，未把文件更新日当作实时库存截止。YQN分仓数量与主表批次日期分源展示。</p>' +
      '<details class="cx-fold sp-wh-fold"' + (!row.warehouses.some(group => group.currentEarliestInbound) && history.length ? ' open' : '') + '><summary>已接入历史入库范围 · ' + history.length + '个仓库 / 包装组</summary><div class="cx-fold-body">' +
      historyTable + '<p class="cx-note">这里是已接入主表当前页及历史页的最早、最近登记，不代表该商品完整生命周期的首次或最后一次到仓。库龄分段未用于倒推日期。</p></div></details>' +
      (batches.length ? '<details class="cx-fold sp-wh-fold"><summary>当前批次原始依据 · ' + batches.length + '条</summary><div class="cx-fold-body">' +
        table(['仓库 / 包装', '柜号', '实际入库', '现存包件 / 同批配齐参考套', '来源'], batches.map(({ group, batch }) => [
          esc(nameOf(group.warehouseCode, group.region)) + small(packLabel(group)), esc(batch.container || '柜号未填'),
          esc(batch.inboundDate), qty(batch.currentCartons) + '箱 / ' + qty(batch.currentCompleteSets) + '套',
          '<span class="sp-wh-source">' + esc(sourceText(batch.currentSources)) + '</span>'
        ])) + '<p class="cx-note">同批配齐参考只在同SKU、同仓、同柜、同入库日和同包装版本内按各包件最小值计算；不覆盖全国库存、不跨批借包。</p></div></details>' : '') + '</section>';
  }

  function etaCell(batch) {
    if (batch.etaStatus === 'conflict') return '<strong class="sp-wh-warning">预计日待确认</strong>' +
      small('船期表：' + (batch.etaCandidates.join(' / ') || '未填')) +
      small('在途登记：' + (batch.registrationEtas.join(' / ') || '未填'));
    if (!batch.eta) return '预计到仓待确认';
    return '<strong>' + esc(batch.eta) + '</strong>' +
      (batch.eta < data.reviewDate ? small('预计日已过，实际到仓未核') : small('预计日期，非实际到仓'));
  }
  function transitHtml(sku, stock) {
    const row = rows.get(sku), transit = stock?.transit;
    if (!row) return '';
    const batches = row.transitBatches;
    const summary = '<div class="sp-wh-transit-summary"><span>当前全国在途：<strong>' + qty(transit) + '套</strong></span>' +
      '<span>预计到仓：<strong>' + (batches.length ? '按下列同柜记录查看' : finite(transit) && transit === 0 ? '当前在途为0' : '待确认') + '</strong></span></div>';
    const body = batches.length ? table(['目的仓 / 区域', '柜号 / 包装', '预计到仓', '核对状态'], batches.map(batch => [
      esc(nameOf(batch.warehouseCode, batch.region)), esc(batch.container || '柜号未填') + small(packLabel(batch)),
      etaCell(batch), esc(batch.etaNote)
    ])) : '<p class="sp-wh-empty">' + (finite(transit) && transit > 0 ? '主表有在途量，但未取得同SKU同柜号的船期关联；预计到仓待确认。' :
      '本次没有可与该精确SKU关联的当前柜号船期；未将历史到仓日当作未来预计日。') + '</p>';
    const references = batches.map(batch => '<li><strong>' + esc(batch.container) + '</strong>：主表 ' +
      esc(sourceText(batch.masterSources)) + '；船期 ' + esc(sourceText(batch.shippingSources) || '待补') +
      (batch.registrationSources.length ? '；在途登记 ' + esc(sourceText(batch.registrationSources)) : '') + '</li>').join('');
    return '<section class="sp-wh-panel" data-sp-warehouse-transit="' + esc(sku) + '"><h3>当前在途与预计到仓</h3>' + summary + body +
      '<p class="cx-note">在途量沿用已核库存模型，不与下方柜号行或区域登记相加。预计日按同SKU、同区域、公司柜号及实物柜号核对；未定位具体仓库时保留“具体仓待确认”。船期和在途登记均为 ' +
      esc(data.shippingDateSource) + ' 导出文件，多个来源日期冲突时保留待确认。</p>' +
      (references ? '<details class="cx-fold sp-wh-fold"><summary>船期匹配来源</summary><div class="cx-fold-body"><ul class="sp-wh-source-list">' + references + '</ul></div></details>' : '') + '</section>';
  }
  function html(sku, stock) { return datesHtml(sku, stock) + transitHtml(sku, stock); }

  function renameWarehouses(content, stock) {
    const labels = new Map();
    for (const group of stock?.warehouseGroups || []) {
      const code = codeOf(group.warehouse);
      if (code) labels.set(String(group.warehouse), nameOf(code, code.split('_')[1]));
    }
    for (const [label, name] of labels) content = content.split(esc(label)).join(esc(name) +
      (label === name ? '' : small('原仓名：' + label)));
    return content;
  }
  if (typeof cxSkuStockHtml === 'function') {
    const previous = cxSkuStockHtml;
    cxSkuStockHtml = function (sku) {
      const stock = typeof cxStock === 'function' ? cxStock(sku) : null;
      let original = renameWarehouses(previous.apply(this, arguments), stock);
      // 新的船期表替代原来固定“具体船期待补”区域；保留其余库存及采购来源。
      original = original.replace(/<h3>当前在途记录<\/h3>[\s\S]*?(?=<details class="cx-fold"><summary>历史采购)/, '');
      return html(sku, stock) + original;
    };
  }
  if (typeof sqStockHtml === 'function') {
    const previous = sqStockHtml;
    sqStockHtml = function (row) {
      const stock = typeof cxStock === 'function' ? cxStock(row.sku) : null;
      return html(row.sku, stock) + renameWarehouses(previous.apply(this, arguments), stock);
    };
  }
  if (typeof nmRenderSku === 'function') {
    const previous = nmRenderSku;
    nmRenderSku = function () {
      const result = previous.apply(this, arguments);
      if (typeof nmState !== 'undefined' && nmState.detailTab === 'stock' && typeof cxState !== 'undefined') {
        const sku = cxState.detail.sku, body = document.getElementById('cxDetailBody');
        if (body && !body.querySelector('[data-sp-warehouse-dates]')) {
          body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html(sku, typeof cxStock === 'function' ? cxStock(sku) : null));
        }
      }
      return result;
    };
  }
  window.spWarehouseModel = { ready: true, data, rows, nameOf, codeOf, currentGroups, datesHtml, transitHtml, html };
})();

</script>
<script>
/* 销量图表交互补丁：保留排名上下文，详情点选独立，日图零值减少标记。 */
(function (root) {
  'use strict';
  if (root.spUiModel?.ready) return;

  const detail = { sku: '', platform: '' };
  let detailChartContext = null;
  const originalRankHtml = biRankHtml;
  const originalTrendHtml = sxTrendHtml;
  const originalSkuCharts = sxSkuCharts;
  const originalOrderTable = cxOrderTable;
  const originalOpenSku = cxOpenSku;
  const originalRenderSales = cxRenderSales;
  const originalSkuEvidence = typeof srSkuEvidence === 'function' ? srSkuEvidence : null;

  function rankItems() {
    return [...cxSalesAggregates(sxOrders({ ignoreSku: true })).values()]
      .sort((a, b) => b.net - a.net || a.sku.localeCompare(b.sku))
      .slice(0, 10)
      .map(row => ({ key: row.sku, label: row.sku, value: row.net }));
  }

  biRankHtml = function () {
    // 只忽略本图SKU点选；日期、平台、店铺、业务范围和其他图形条件仍然生效。
    const items = rankItems(), selected = cxState.sales.sku;
    let html = originalRankHtml(items);
    html = html.replace('class="bi-rank"', 'class="bi-rank sp-rank' + (selected ? ' has-sku-selection' : '') + '"');
    if (selected) html = html.replace(/<div class="bi-rank-row ([^"]*)"/g, (tag, classes) =>
      classes.split(/\s+/).includes('is-selected') ? tag : '<div class="bi-rank-row ' + (classes + ' is-muted').trim() + '"');
    return html;
  };

  cxRenderSales = function () {
    const result = originalRenderSales();
    const host = cxEl('cxSalesBody');
    const note = host?.querySelector('.sp-rank')?.closest('.cx-chart')?.querySelector('.cx-note');
    if (note) note.textContent = '排名保留日期、平台、店铺等筛选范围。点击柱形高亮该SKU，其余项变淡，指标和明细联动；再次点击恢复。点击SKU名称查看详情。';
    const contextNote = host?.querySelector('.bi-context-note');
    if (contextNote) contextNote.textContent = contextNote.textContent.replace('Top10、指标、明细和导出按点选统计。', 'Top10保留当前排名；指标、明细和导出按点选统计。');
    return result;
  };

  function attrValue(attributes, name) {
    return new RegExp('(?:^|\\s)' + name + '="([^"]*)"').exec(attributes)?.[1] || '';
  }

  function hasClass(attributes, name) {
    return attrValue(attributes, 'class').split(/\s+/).includes(name);
  }

  function cleanDailyTrendHtml(html, orders, options) {
    if (options.grain !== 'day' || sxTrendMode(options) === 'bar') return html;
    const buckets = sxTrendBuckets(orders, options), zero = new Set(), known = new Set(), nonzero = new Set();
    for (const bucket of buckets) {
      if (!bucket.covered) continue;
      for (const [series, value] of Object.entries(bucket.values)) {
        if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) continue;
        known.add(series);
        if (value === 0) zero.add(bucket.key + '|' + series);
        else nonzero.add(series);
      }
    }
    const emptySeries = new Set([...known].filter(series => !nonzero.has(series)));
    const bucketAttribute = /^data-[a-z0-9_-]+$/.test(options.actionAttribute || '') ? options.actionAttribute : 'data-sx-bucket';
    // 已覆盖的真零只隐藏标记和标签，原折线仍经过0；未覆盖日期保留空缺和灰区。
    html = html.replace(/<(circle|text|line|polyline)\b([^>]*)>[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/g, (tag, name, attributes) => {
      const series = attrValue(attributes, 'data-sx-series');
      if (!series) return tag;
      const point = ['sx-trend-point', 'sx-trend-point-label', 'sx-trend-point-guide'].some(value => hasClass(attributes, value));
      if (point && zero.has(attrValue(attributes, bucketAttribute) + '|' + series)) return '';
      if (emptySeries.has(series) && (hasClass(attributes, 'sx-trend-line') || hasClass(attributes, 'sx-trend-line-hit'))) return '';
      return tag;
    });
    // 整个观察窗均为0的平台不画贴着基线的光效，平台图例仍完整保留。
    return html.replace(/<g\b([^>]*)>[\s\S]*?<\/g>/g, (tag, attributes) =>
      hasClass(attributes, 'sx-trend-tracer') && emptySeries.has(attrValue(attributes, 'data-sx-series')) ? '' : tag);
  }

  function detailPlatform(sku = cxState.detail.sku) {
    if (detail.sku !== sku) Object.assign(detail, { sku, platform: '' });
    return detail.platform;
  }

  function filterDetailOrders(orders, includeDateAndClass = false) {
    const platform = detailPlatform();
    const bucket = includeDateAndClass ? sxBucketBounds(sxState.detailBucket, sxState.detailGrain) : null;
    return orders.filter(order => (!platform || order.platform === platform)
      && (!bucket || order.date >= bucket.start && order.date <= bucket.end)
      && (!includeDateAndClass || !sxState.detailClass || sxClass(order)?.stockClass === sxState.detailClass));
  }

  function detailLegendHtml(html, selected) {
    return html.replace(/<span\b([^>]*class="sx-trend-legend-item[^"]*"[^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/span>/g, (tag, attributes, content) => {
      const platform = attrValue(attributes, 'data-sx-series');
      if (!sxPlatforms.some(group => group.key === platform)) return tag;
      const active = selected === platform, label = sxPlatformName(platform);
      return '<button type="button"' + attributes + ' data-sp-detail-platform="' + cxEsc(platform)
        + '" aria-pressed="' + active + '" title="' + cxEsc('仅查看本SKU的' + label + '订单；再点恢复全部平台') + '">' + content + '</button>';
    });
  }

  sxTrendHtml = function (orders, options = {}) {
    const isDetail = Boolean(detailChartContext && options.actionAttribute === 'data-sx-detail-bucket');
    const selected = isDetail ? detailPlatform(detailChartContext.sku) : '';
    const configured = isDetail ? { ...options, highlightPlatforms: selected ? [selected] : [], combinePlatformAndBucket: Boolean(selected) } : options;
    let html = cleanDailyTrendHtml(originalTrendHtml(orders, configured), orders, configured);
    if (isDetail) html = detailLegendHtml(html, selected);
    return html;
  };

  cxOrderTable = function (orders, page = 0, context = 'sales') {
    if (context !== 'detail' || cxState.detail.tab !== 'charts') return originalOrderTable(orders, page, context);
    const filtered = filterDetailOrders(orders), lastPage = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(filtered.length / 35) - 1);
    const currentPage = Math.max(0, Math.min(page, lastPage));
    if (detailChartContext) detailChartContext.tableRows = filtered.length;
    cxState.detail.orderPage = currentPage;
    return originalOrderTable(filtered, currentPage, context);
  };

  sxSkuCharts = function (sku) {
    detailPlatform(sku);
    const previous = detailChartContext, context = { sku, tableRows: null };
    detailChartContext = context;
    try {
      let html = originalSkuCharts(sku);
      if (context.tableRows !== null) html = html.replace(/(<summary>所选日期商品行 · )\d+(条)/, '$1' + context.tableRows + '$2');
      const selected = detailPlatform(sku);
      return '<div class="sp-detail-selection" aria-live="polite"><span>点击图例查看对应平台订单 · 当前：<strong>'
        + cxEsc(selected ? sxPlatformName(selected) : '全部平台') + '</strong></span>'
        + (selected ? '<button type="button" data-sp-detail-platform="">恢复三平台</button>' : '')
        + '<small>此处点选仅影响本SKU详情。</small></div>' + html;
    } finally {
      detailChartContext = previous;
    }
  };

  // 保持详情下方的逐行采购依据与同一日期、平台选择一致；来源内容沿用既有白名单输出。
  if (originalSkuEvidence) srSkuEvidence = function (sku) {
    if (cxState.detail.tab !== 'charts') return originalSkuEvidence(sku);
    const orders = filterDetailOrders(sxOrders({ ignoreSku: true }).filter(order => order.sku === sku), true);
    const period = srSelectedPeriod(), bucket = sxBucketBounds(sxState.detailBucket, sxState.detailGrain), selected = detailPlatform(sku);
    return '<details class="cx-fold sr-sku-evidence" open><summary>本次所选商品行与采购分类 · ' + orders.length
      + '条</summary><div class="cx-fold-body"><p class="cx-note">' + cxEsc((bucket ? bucket.start + '—' + bucket.end : period.start + '—' + period.end)
        + ' · 沿主页面业务范围，并按本SKU详情日期及平台筛选' + (selected ? '（' + sxPlatformName(selected) + '）' : '') + '；数量及商品额来自订单源。')
      + '</p>' + cxTable(['日期／平台店铺', '订单／原SKU', '采购属性', '原订购／本期数量', '商品行金额', '来源与依据'], orders.map(order => [
        cxEsc(order.date) + cxSmall(sxPlatformName(order.platform) + ' / ' + order.store),
        '<button class="cx-order-link" data-cx-order="' + cxEsc(cxOrderKey(order)) + '">' + cxEsc(order.orderId) + '</button>' + cxSmall(order.shopSku || '未填SKU'),
        cxEsc(srClassLabels[srClass(order)]), cxQty(order.quantity) + ' / ' + (sxAnnual() ? cxQty(order.quantity) : cxRange(order.netLower, order.netUpper)),
        cxAmountEligible(order) ? cxMoney(order.amount) : '不计图表' + cxSmall(cxMoney(order.amount)),
        cxEsc(order.sourcePath || '') + cxSmall(order.sourceRow) + srSourceEvidence(order)
      ])) + '</div></details>';
  };

  cxOpenSku = function (sku) {
    Object.assign(detail, { sku, platform: '' });
    return originalOpenSku(sku);
  };

  function selectDetailPlatform(platform, redraw = true) {
    detailPlatform();
    if (platform && !sxPlatforms.some(group => group.key === platform)) return false;
    detail.platform = detail.platform === platform ? '' : platform;
    cxState.detail.orderPage = 0;
    if (redraw) cxRenderSku();
    return true;
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-sp-detail-platform]');
    if (!button) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    selectDetailPlatform(button.dataset.spDetailPlatform);
  }, true);

  root.spUiModel = {
    ready: false, version: '20261116-sales-chart-polish',
    rankItems, cleanDailyTrendHtml, filterDetailOrders, selectDetailPlatform,
    getDetailSelection: () => ({ ...detail })
  };
  if (cxState.view === 'sales') cxRenderSales();
  root.spUiModel.ready = true;
})(window);

</script>
<script>
/* 近30天动销按所选统计末日回溯；读取当前筛选，不修改主页面日期状态。 */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 function window30(){
  const coverage=sxCoverage(),selected=srSelectedPeriod(),requestedEnd=selected.end||sxState.end,end=requestedEnd<coverage.end?requestedEnd:coverage.end;
  if(selected.empty||selected.start>selected.end||!end||end<coverage.start)return {start:'',end,empty:true,partial:true,rows:[],count:null};
  const requestedStart=sxAdd(end,-29),start=requestedStart>coverage.start?requestedStart:coverage.start,s=cxState.sales,q=s.search.trim().toLowerCase();
  let rows=(pcRuntime[sxDataset()]||[]).filter(order=>order.date>=start&&order.date<=end&&pcOrderIncluded(order,s.stockScope)
   &&(!s.platform||order.platform===s.platform)&&(!sxState.chartPlatform||order.platform===sxState.chartPlatform)
   &&(!sxState.store||order.store===sxState.store)&&(!s.sku||order.sku===s.sku)
   &&(!sxState.stockClass||sxClass(order)?.stockClass===sxState.stockClass)
   &&(!bxState.history||bxHistoryClass(order)===bxState.history)
   &&(!q||[order.sku,order.shopSku,order.store,order.orderId,order.srProductName,cxGetProduct(order.sku)?.productName].some(value=>String(value||'').toLowerCase().includes(q))));
  rows=ldApply(rows);
  const units=new Map();for(const order of rows){if(!sxValidOrder(order))continue;units.set(order.sku,(units.get(order.sku)||0)+cxNet(order));}
  return {start,end,requestedStart,empty:false,partial:start!==requestedStart,rows,count:[...units.values()].filter(value=>value>0).length};
 }
 const previous=ovOverviewHtml;
 ovOverviewHtml=function(context){
  const model=window30(),label='近30天有动销SKU数量',period=model.empty?'所选末日没有已覆盖销量':model.start+'—'+model.end+(model.partial?' · 覆盖不足30天':''),basis=sxAnnual()?'历史参考数量 >0；非净销量':'有效订单已核净数量下界 >0',card=ovKpi('codes',label,model.empty?'未覆盖':cxQty(model.count),period,{title:'截至所选统计末日回溯30个自然日；沿平台、店铺、SKU、业务范围及其他筛选，按归并SKU去重。'+basis+'。库存与非库存SKU均按当前业务范围纳入；不等于当前有库存的SKU数。'});
  let html=previous(context);
  html=html.replace(/<div class="ov-kpi [^"]*" data-ov-kpi="codes"[\s\S]*?<\/div>/,card);
  html=html.replace(/<summary>商品码怎么统计？[\s\S]*?<\/summary><p>[\s\S]*?<\/p>/,'<summary>近30天动销SKU怎么统计？<span>'+ovEsc(period)+'</span></summary><p>按所选统计末日回溯30个自然日，保留当前平台、店铺、SKU和业务范围等筛选；'+ovEsc(basis)+'的归并SKU去重计数。所选起始日期不截短此30天窗口；不足30天覆盖时仅显示已覆盖记录。库存与非库存SKU均按所选业务范围计入，不代表当前有货款数。</p>');
  return html;
 };
 window.spKpiModel={window30};
 if(cxState.view==='sales')ovRenderOverview();
})();

</script>
